content: {"episode_id":"ep-05160","cpt":"93247","denial_carc":"PR-204","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93247, long-term continuous ECG monitoring, is medically necessary for this patient, who presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent dizziness (R42) that have persisted despite initial management for supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1). The monitoring study is indicated to further characterize the arrhythmia and correlate the patient's symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances. Without this extended monitoring, the arrhythmia underlying the patient's continuing symptoms cannot be characterized. We therefore request reconsideration of the PR-204 denial and coverage of CPT 93247."}
